✅ VERDICT: GREEN — All clear. Proceed.

⚠️  Warnings:
   • Turning a silent Infinity into a thrown exception can crash any uncaught call path that used to keep running.
   • Callers without try/catch will now throw at runtime
   • NaN divisors (0/0 cases or NaN input) are not covered by a b === 0 check
   • Floating-point near-zero divisors (1e-320) still give huge results

✅ Recommended: Check existing call sites for zero divisors, and decide explicitly whether NaN and non-finite inputs should also throw.
